name: SculptureCenter
funding: Expenses $2.6M (FY2025). Teiger, Kellen, Warhol, Lambent, Hartwig, Woodner and Frankenthaler funds. NYSCA and NYC Cultural Affairs. An international council of collectors.

name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
funding: $72M annual operating budget. Admissions, Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation endowment, Lavazza, BMW Group cultural partnerships.

name: Swiss Institute
funding: Pro Helvetia, NYSCA and NYC Cultural Affairs (2025-26); Warhol, Arison Arts, Frankenthaler, LUMA and Goldsmith foundations. Blavatnik Family Foundation gave in 2020 and 2021, Bloomberg Philanthropies in 2018 and 2019.

name: The Drawing Center
funding: $3.5M expenses (2023); Toll family, Warhol/Mellon/Frankenthaler foundations, NYC DCLA and NYSCA, galleries, UNIQLO.

name: The Kitchen
funding: Mellon gave $2M in 2023. Its About page thanks Bloomberg Philanthropies as a supporter. FY2025 revenue was $2.4M, of which $2.1M was contributions, against $3.4M expenses.

name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met)
funding: $330M+ annual budget; $4.4B endowment. City of New York municipal support, admissions, Bloomberg Philanthropies, Tiffany & Co., Bank of America, Leonard A. Lauder bequests.

name: Whitney Museum of American Art
funding: $105M annual operating budget. Admissions, board patron giving, Hyundai Motor, Tiffany & Co., Genesis philanthropic initiatives.

name: Chrysler Museum of Art
funding: $18.4M expenses (2023). City of Norfolk plus private donors. Founding gift from Walter Chrysler Jr (car fortune).

name: MASS MoCA
funding: Massachusetts Cultural Council, Barr Foundation, NEA, admissions and individual philanthropy.

name: Oakland Museum of California
funding: Expenses $20.4M (FY2025); City of Oakland subsidy, foundation trustees, members.

name: Bemis Center
funding: Sponsor page, $20,000+ tier: Mellon, Art Bridges, NEA, Nebraska Arts Council, Sherwood, Holland, Heider and Hubbard foundations, Douglas County, National Indemnity, Omaha Steaks. 2024 expenses $2.4M.
